notes:
ATTEMPT 3. The MAJOR is resolved.

Attempt 2's fault was not geometry — the bias angles had been measured correct to a tenth of a degree — but FINISH at the exact focal point: a neck button rendered as a dished chrome disc with four bare holes and no sewing thread, beside a buttonhole that was a smeared, whiskered smudge. For an option sold as 'standard precision construction throughout', a thread-less button and a frayed buttonhole contradict the thing being sold. That is why it was a major rather than a cosmetic nitpick.

The correction that worked described the ARTEFACT in tailoring terms rather than asking for better quality: a flat nacreous button, matte not mirrored, four holes each crossed by dark thread with a visible shank; a straight slit bound by dense whipstitching with a bar tack at each end. 'Render it well' would not have landed. This is the same pattern as the hidden-button and red-annotation fixes — name the construction, not the complaint.

All nine categories at or above 95 with zero Critical or Major findings, so this qualifies for the logged waiver at attempt 3.
